newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Man trapped in Brazil well for three days dies.
newsitem.headline: Man trapped in Brazil well for three days dies.

text.p: A 61-year-old man, buried in sand up to his neck for three days at the bottom of a well in northern Brazil, died Sunday after attempts to rescue him failed, authorities said.
"Everything was tried. They even brought in a helicopter. But it was no use," a fire department spokesman in Belem, capital of the northern state of Para, told reporters.

Luiz Jose de Salas survived some 76 hours after sand walls collapsed around him on Thursday as he was cleaning out a 50-foot (15 metres) deep well in the town of Igarape-Azu, outside Belem, the spokesman said.
Fire fighters, using compressors to remove the sand, were close to extracting him when his vital signs gave out, the spokesman added.
Rescue workers, whose efforts were stumped for days for fear the well's walls would completely collapse if they tried to dig him out, kept Salas alive by lowering food, water and oxygen.
On Saturday night, an exhausted Salas told a television crew that had lowered a microphone down the well he was suffering pains in his sides. By late Sunday, his body had not yet been extracted.
